name: alpha
description: capital share: 1 minus compensation / (compensation + gross operating surplus), 1990-2019

name: beta
description: discount factor: from the Euler equation, 1 / (1 + alpha Y/K - delta)

name: h
description: share of time worked: actual hours per person aged 15-64 / 100 hours a week, 1990-2019

name: theta
description: weight on leisure: set so the household works the share h

name: rho
description: technology persistence: AR(1) of the detrended Solow residual, 1976Q1-2019Q4

name: sigma
description: technology shock standard deviation: same regression, 1976Q1-2019Q4

name: investment_output
description: data and model: private investment / GDP, current prices

name: capital_output
description: data and model: private produced capital / quarterly GDP

name: consumption_output_data
description: consumption / GDP in the data, current prices

name: consumption_output_model
description: consumption / output in the model, which has no government or trade

name: hours_per_week
description: actual hours worked per person aged 15-64 per week, 1990-2019

name: frisch_elasticity
description: Frisch elasticity of hours implied by log leisure: (1 - h) / h

name: technology_trend_growth
description: linear trend of the Solow residual, per cent a year

name: stable_root
description: capital's root in the log-linear model
